direct_reconstruction_rule: Only an official/released continuous-expression inference path may enter the P3 16K reconstruction benchmark.
geneformer: Representation/downstream comparator unless an official continuous reconstruction decoder is independently verified.
scfoundation: Priority direct reconstruction model because P2 established an official continuous decoder; repeat mapping and inference against the P3 16K feature space.
scgpt: Compatibility audit unless an official reproducible continuous-expression inverse exists.
